title.en: Hooke's law and the stress–strain curve

heading.en: Pull a spring, then pull harder

hook.en: Hang one coin on a spring and it stretches a little. Hang two and it stretches twice as much. But keep adding coins and one day the spring never comes back.

say.en: Hang one coin on a spring and it stretches a little. Hang two and it stretches twice as much. But keep adding coins and one day the spring never comes back. In this lesson: State Hooke's law.
Read the stress-strain curve of a metal.

body.en: For small deformations, *stress* is proportional to strain: stress = k × strain. The constant k is the modulus of elasticity of the material. For a spring the same idea reads F = kx, where k is the spring constant.
body.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿರೂಪಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲವು ವಿಕೃತಿಗೆ ನೇರ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ: ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ = k × ವಿಕೃತಿ. k ಎಂಬುದು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಗುಣಾಂಕ. ಸ್ಪ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ F = kx.

say.en: k is called the modulus of elasticity.
Load a metal wire slowly and plot stress against strain.
At first the graph is a straight line from O to A. Stress is proportional to strain: this is Hooke's law. A is the proportional limit.
Up to B, the yield point, the wire returns to its length when unloaded. B is the elastic limit.
Beyond B the deformation is plastic: a permanent set remains. D is the ultimate tensile strength, and the wire breaks at E.
If D and E are far apart the metal is ductile, like copper. If they are close it is brittle, like cast iron.
For a spring, Hooke's law reads F = kx. A spring with k = 200 newton per metre stretched by 5 centimetres pulls back with 10 newton.

narration.en: Up to A stress is proportional to strain (Hooke's law). Up to B, the yield point, the wire still returns to its length when unloaded. Beyond B it flows plastically and keeps a permanent set; D is the ultimate tensile strength and at E it breaks. The shape is typical of a ductile metal; the numbers are not to scale.
narration.kn: A ವರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ ವಿಕೃತಿಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತ (ಹುಕ್ ನಿಯಮ). B (ಇಳುವರಿ ಬಿಂದು) ವರೆಗೆ ಭಾರ ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ತಂತಿ ಮೂಲ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತದೆ. B ನಂತರ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಆಗಿ ಹರಿದು ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; D ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಎಳೆತ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ, E ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಕಾರ ತನ್ಯ ಲೋಹಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ; ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ಪ್ರಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: For a metal wire the graph is a straight line up to the proportional limit. Up to the yield point (elastic limit) the wire returns to its length when unloaded. Beyond it the deformation is plastic and a permanent set remains. The highest *stress* on the curve is the ultimate tensile strength, after which the wire necks and fractures. Ductile metals have a long plastic region; brittle ones break soon after the elastic limit. Elastomers such as rubber and the aorta stretch a lot but have no straight-line part.
body.kn: ಲೋಹದ ತಂತಿಯ ನಕ್ಷೆಯು ಅನುಪಾತ ಮಿತಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮಿತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ವಿರೂಪ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲವೇ ಅಂತಿಮ ಕರ್ಷಕ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ; ನಂತರ ತಂತಿ ತುಂಡಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತನ್ಯ ಲೋಹಗಳಿಗೆ ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಭಾಗವಿದೆ.

problem.en: A spring stretches by 2 cm under a load of 4 N. Find its spring constant and its extension under 10 N (within the elastic limit).

steps.en: Extension under 10 N: x = F/k = 10/200 = 0.05 m.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A spring stretches by 2 cm under a load of 4 N. Find its spring constant and its extension under 10 N (within the elastic limit).

say.en: Let us solve this together. A spring stretches by 2 centimetres under a load of 4 newtons. Find its spring constant and its extension under 10 newtons within the elastic limit.
k equals F over x equals 4 divided by 0.02 equals 200 newtons m to the power minus 1.
Extension under 10 newtons: x equals F over k equals 10 over 200 equals 0.05 metres.
So the answer is k equals 200 newtons m to the power minus 1; extension equals 5 centimetres.

homework.en: Sketch a stress–strain curve for a metal and mark the proportional limit, yield point, ultimate strength and fracture point.

narration.en: Recap. Hooke's law: stress ∝ strain for small deformations. Beyond the yield point, a permanent set remains. Ultimate tensile strength is the highest stress before fracture. Ductile: long plastic region; brittle: short; elastomers: no linear part.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಹುಕ್‌ನ ನಿಯಮ: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿರೂಪಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ ∝ ವಿಕೃತಿ. ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮಿತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ವಿರೂಪ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ತುಂಡಾಗುವ ಮೊದಲಿನ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲವೇ ಅಂತಿಮ ಕರ್ಷಕ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ. ತನ್ಯ: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಭಾಗ; ಭಂಗುರ: ಚಿಕ್ಕದು; ಎಲಾಸ್ಟೋಮರ್: ಸರಳರೇಖೆ ಇಲ್ಲ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Hooke's law: stress is proportional to strain for small deformations.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಹುಕ್‌ನ ನಿಯಮ: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿರೂಪಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ is proportional to ವಿಕೃತಿ.

say.en: Beyond the yield point, a permanent set remains.
say.kn: ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಮಿತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ವಿರೂಪ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Ultimate tensile strength is the highest stress before fracture.
say.kn: ತುಂಡಾಗುವ ಮೊದಲಿನ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲವೇ ಅಂತಿಮ ಕರ್ಷಕ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ.

say.en: Ductile: long plastic region; brittle: short; elastomers: no linear part.
say.kn: ತನ್ಯ: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಭಾಗ; ಭಂಗುರ: ಚಿಕ್ಕದು; ಎಲಾಸ್ಟೋಮರ್: ಸರಳರೇಖೆ ಇಲ್ಲ.
